description: Verify a Vouchwell evidence bundle file using nothing but the file itself. Pin the signer with log_keys (kid=publicKey, as the log owner published them) to also prove who signed it.

log_keys.description: Trusted signing keys, kid → base64url public key. Without them, the bundle is checked against the keys it carries.

path.description: The bundle file, relative to the working directory or absolute.

name: check_bundle
title: Check an evidence bundle
